event.claim: Transfer-financing formally launched, directly expanding brokers' funding sources for margin-financing business.
After 10 trading days, market margin-financing balance was nearly RMB3bn above Aug-29 and Securities Finance had lent RMB7.1bn, near its RMB7.5bn initial capital ceiling.
Eleven pilot brokers, including Haitong, submitted financing instructions of RMB500m each, for about RMB5.5bn in aggregate.

candidates.name: 海通证券

baselineEvidence.claim: Haitong generated about RMB218m margin-financing interest income in 2012H1, among the industry leaders; its Q1 margin-financing balance share was about 10%.
Board approved participation in transfer-financing business, subject to regulatory approval.

risks: 6% transfer-financing funding cost limited incremental spread
large brokers had own capital and might not need external funding
bear-market client demand may cap utilization

baselineEvidence.claim: H1 margin-financing balance about RMB5.01bn, 8.2% market share, ranking third; H1 margin-financing interest income about RMB163m.

nextGate: freeze 20/60/120d price absorption at 2012-09-14 and select only if exposure asymmetry remains acceptable.
